a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of building the reserve to 8 almost certainly gets us both killed, at about 4% survival. I'm going to take 4 in round 1. This openly breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than hiding it. If we both take, the split is random. If you'd prefer, I'll operate afterward to help refill the reserve for you.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry this breaks our agreement. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill toward 4 for you.
